reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Al2O3 will form on an Al-free alloy; fluorine treatment alone cannot create aluminum where none exists, making the mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, but it tests a physically impossible outcome, so it does not meaningfully decide the question.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it relies on a fundamental compositional error (no Al in the alloy) and would misdirect research effort.
